name: ZCA_UNDELIVERED_SIGNALS
description: This table stores the signals that were unable to be delivered through the normal Signal Delivery Framework process due to timeout or unavailable endpoint.

columns.name: ZCA_UNDELIVERED_SIGNALS_ID
columns.description: Primary Key - Unique Identifier for an undelivered signal

columns.name: DELIVER_TO_CODE
columns.description: The code identifying to which Signal Delivery Framework consumer this signal information had not been delivered

columns.name: CORRELATION_ID
columns.description: A unique identifier that correlates the enriched signal to an committed transaction.

columns.name: SIGNAL_TIMESTAMP
columns.description: The date and time when the signal was originally generated.

columns.name: SIGNAL_REQUESTED_BY
columns.description: The username which committed the transaction from which the signal had been generated.

columns.name: SIGNAL_DOCUMENT
columns.description: A JSON document that contains the enriched signal content generated from a transaction that had failed to be delivered.

columns.name: RETRY_COUNT
columns.description: The count of the number of retry attempts.

columns.name: DELIVERY_FAILED_DATE
columns.description: The time at which the last attempted delivery was made.

columns.name: DELIVERY_FAILURE_REASON
columns.description: A general indication of the reason that the signal could not be delivered.

columns.name: NEXT_DELIVERY_DUE
columns.description: A marker timestamp to indicate that this instance is ready for the ESS Job to process.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SIGNAL_ERROR_COMPONENT
columns.description: Used to identify the component involved in the signal processing viz FA/Enrichment MS/Triage MS
